title: Pluggable Subband-Decoupled Fusion and Unlabeled Capture Prototype Calibration: Bridging High-SNR Null-Subcarrier Regrowth and Low-SNR Coherent Preambles for Cross-Domain IoT RF Fingerprinting
abstract: arXiv:2611.22812v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Zero-overhead physical-layer authentication at edge wireless access points (APs) is vital for securing resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) transceivers against credential cloning, yet cross-domain IEEE 802.11a/g radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) faces an acute signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) crossover. Power-amplifier spectral regrowth on unpopulated null subcarriers resists indoor multipath at high SNR but decays quadratically below the thermal noise floor, whereas populated active in-band preambles survive low SNR yet degrade under severe multipath, causing static fusion to lose up to 44.7 percentage points (pp). To our knowledge, we propose the first RFFI framework that dynamically modulates active in-band waveforms and unpopulated null-subcarrier regrowth via a blind physical SNR gate: Pluggable Gated Subband-Decoupled Fusion with Unlabeled Capture-Aware Prototype Calibration (GSDF-CAPC). translated_title: 可插拔子带解耦融合与无标签采集原型校准：为跨域物联网射频指纹识别架起高信噪比空子载波再生与低信噪比相干前导码之间的桥梁
translated_abstract: 边缘无线接入点（AP）的零开销物理层认证对于保护资源受限的物联网收发器免受凭证克隆攻击至关重要，然而跨域IEEE 802.11a/g射频指纹识别面临严峻的信噪比交叉问题。功率放大器在未占用空子载波上的频谱再生在高信噪比下能够抵抗室内多径效应，但在低于热噪声底时会发生二次方衰减；而占用的带内有效前导码虽然能在低信噪比下存活，却在严重多径环境下性能退化，导致静态融合方案最多损失44.7个百分点。据我们所知，我们提出了首个通过盲物理信噪比门控动态调节带内有效波形与空子载波再生特征的射频指纹识别框架：具有无标签采集感知原型校准的可插拔门控子带解耦融合（GSDF-CAPC）。该框架避免了20-35 dB的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个基于盲物理信噪比门控的射频指纹识别框架GSDF-CAPC，通过可插拔子带解耦融合动态权衡高信噪比下抗多径的空子载波频谱再生特征与低信噪比下稳健的带内相干前导码特征，并辅以无标签采集感知原型校准，解决了跨域物联网设备认证中信噪比交叉导致静态融合性能大幅下降的问题。
en_tdlr: We propose GSDF-CAPC, the first RFFI framework that employs a blind physical SNR gate with pluggable subband-decoupled fusion to dynamically balance multipath-resistant null-subcarrier spectral regrowth at high SNR and robust in-band coherent preambles at low SNR, complemented by unlabeled capture-aware prototype calibration, thereby overcoming the SNR crossover problem in cross-domain IoT device authentication.
